searchText: I'm looking for an implementation (at least a working prototype) of stateless client. The following video says there is one written in Javascript but I can't find it easily. (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=yFJxVSbQNcI - 17:00) Can anyone point me where to look into if I want to catch up the status of quo of stateless client? <@864461065693036554> worked on that I believe, in cohort-four. https://discord.com/channels/595666850260713488/843176491386667018/1219606962853904384 Hi everyone , I am a bit late but I am looking forward to join permissionlessly Thanks for the reference! Actually I skimmed it and thought it's a proposal without implementation, but it turns out it has PoC code. I wonder if there is any production-level effort though 🤔 hmm... Anyway, I'll dive into Verkle and statelessness more, thanks! Production level efforts will likely begin around/after Verkle is deployed on mainnet Well it is possible with Merkle Patricia Trees*, the proof sizes aren’t so generous, to the point it is considered infeasible without Verkle.
